pages.title: Tastes Like Chicken
pages.text: Race 8: Toronto, 10.3 km. Password: JAYS, for the Blue Jays, baseball's champions of 1992 and 1993, the two years the game was made in. Skitchin' (EA, 1994), Mega Drive / Genesis. Music by Jeff van Dyck.

pages.title: The stuntman
pages.text: At Toronto's Skate Ranch the team asked for the best skater around and met Troy Mannering. In a warehouse he was towed behind a programmer's car to hit the ramps, and the film was traced into the game.

pages.title: TROY
pages.text: There is a secret password with his name: TROY, for 'improved fighting'. The whole team, says Warfield, felt the car's carbon monoxide for the rest of that day.
